Table 2: The SCGWs and emissions when different uncertainty channels are activated. Columns 1 and 3 show outcomes for the less uncertainty aversion case. Columns 2 and 4 show outcomes for the more uncertainty aversion case. Each row shows the outcomes when activating different uncertainty channels: no uncertainty (row 1), only climate model (row 2), only damage model (row 3), only capital productivity (row 4), only R&D technology (row 5), and all channels (row 6). The numbers in the parentheses for the SCGWs are the values in each row as a percentage of the “all channels” outcomes.
